response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10
